name: Story rings open
oneLiner: a row of avatar coins in story rings (brand gradient for new, grey for seen) pops in from the middle out; a finger taps the real face in the centre, its ring breaks into spinning dashes while it loads, then the face grows out of the ring into a full 9:16 story frame (segmented progress, header, a brand screen card, the headline) while the row falls away and the first segment runs
say: when the speaker says they posted it to their story or shows what they share day to day ('I put it on my story', 'every day I post a quick update'): the ring is tapped on 'story' and the frame opens on the update
